headline: OpenAI launches cheaper, faster GPT-6.1 Terra model
summary: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra, a budget mid-tier model aimed at computer use, visual reasoning and coding. It's reported as 3x faster for agents with 50% lower pricing, and about a tenth of the cost of OpenAI's Astra API, while still rivaling pricier models on some tasks.
